title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Cross Margin and Portfolio Margin (2026-08-28)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance will update the  Cross Margin Borrow and Transfer-out collateral ratio ,  Portfolio Margin collateral ratio , and  Tiered Collateral Ratio for Portfolio Margin Pro  for the following assets from  2026-08-28 06:00 (UTC).  The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes . Collateral ratio and leverage  will affect  the Unified Maintenance Margin Ratio (uniMMR) under Portfolio Margin. Users should monitor uniMMR closely to avoid any potential liquidation or losses that may result from the change of collateral ratio and leverage.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
